title: EvoProbe: Evaluation-Driven Benchmark Evolution for LLM Agents
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We propose EvoProbe, an evaluation-driven benchmark evolution framework that integrates task generation, diagnostic evaluation, and feedback-driven regeneration into a closed loop.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Static benchmarks for large language model (LLM) agents face saturation and data contamination risks, motivating continual updates to evaluation tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: It combines verifiable subtask outcome scoring with evidence-supported multi-judge trajectory evaluation and distills phase-level bottlenecks, success patterns, and failure patterns into diagnostic feedback for generating new executable tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a cross-round comparison with the Examiner model set and solver configuration held fixed, all eight models achieve lower Outcome scores on the updated tasks, with relative decreases of 11.8\% in mean Outcome and 40.0\% in mean Pass\textasciicircum{}3.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Across two rounds of cybersecurity experiments, evaluations of eight models on 66 tasks reveal phase-level performance differences and common failure patterns beyond aggregate scores.
